title: Hosted API behavioral contracts and operational launch playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD and launch playbook that defines behavioral contracts for hosted inference endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank), operational runbooks, compatibility guarantees, and an acceptance checklist for GA. This ticket consolidates behavioral-level API expectations (response shapes, error semantics, rate-limits, token billing behavior) so integrations and SDKs can rely on stable contracts during rollout.
goals: Define explicit behavioral contracts per endpoint (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) including structured output rules and failure modes
Document compatibility matrix and deprecation policy for minor model or schema changes
Provide a step-by-step launch checklist for Canary → Progressive Rollout → GA with fallback policies
Surface all engineering and infra dependencies and required SLOs for customer-facing SLA
non_goals: Designing new model architectures or training data changes (this ticket only covers serving contracts and rollout)
Implementing SDK language bindings (SDKs will follow the contract and be separate tickets)
Permanent changes to billing model or pricing tiers (out of scope for this launch)
scope_included: Behavioral contract docs for Chat API: message semantics, streaming and non-streaming parity, function/tool-calling signals
Completions: temperature/penalty parameter semantics, stop-sequence handling, n-best behavior
Embeddings: vector dimensionality guarantees, normalization expectations, deterministic indexing behavior
Rerank: input/output schema, tie-breaking rules, score normalization, pagination
Failure and retry semantics: idempotency keys, 4xx versus 5xx definitions, recommended retry backoff
Operational runbooks: canary criteria, health checks, rollback triggers, incident playbooks
scope_excluded: On-prem/offline installer packaging (handled by Private product team)
Dedicated capacity autoscaling UI enhancements (handled by Dedicated program)
Billing pricing changes or rate plan rework
api_surface: /v1/chat: accepts conversation arrays; streaming via chunked events; function calling uses explicit function schema field
/v1/completions: accepts prompt or prompt references; deterministic stop sequence semantics; n and best_of behavior defined
/v1/embeddings: accepts single or batched inputs, returns fixed-length float vector as 'embedding' field; guarantee: dimension 1536 for selected model family
/v1/rerank: accepts list of candidate items and query; returns ordered list with score field and optional explainability hints
acceptance_criteria: All endpoint contracts documented in the API spec doc with example requests and responses for edge cases
SDK tests (python/js) demonstrate compatibility with current GA client behavior using the contract
Integration tests show consistent behavior across hosted regions (us-west1, eu-west1) with <1% variance in response shape
SLOs defined and validated in staging: p99 latency targets met for typical 512-token chat requests under canary traffic
Canary criteria defined and automated: error rate < 0.5% and token-cost delta within threshold
Fallback policy implemented: automatic fallback to compatible model variant if primary model fails or is degraded
Security review completed and signed off by Security team; data handling notes included for embeddings
Migration docs and deprecation windows published for any previously undocumented behavioral changes
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal alpha — feature flag enabled for internal Redwood accounts and infra teams for 1 week
Stage 1: Canary — 1% of production traffic routed to new contract implementation across two regions; automated metrics monitored
Stage 2: Progressive rollout — expand to 10%/33%/67%/100% over a two-week period subject to canary gates
Stage 3: GA — remove feature flag, publish release notes, and notify partners and integrators
Rollback plan: immediate revert to previous runtime build if canary fails gating criteria; transparent incident notes and follow-ups
launch_checklist: Documentation: API behavior doc published + changelog entries for any behavior changes
Tests: unit, integration, cross-region regression tests passed and flakiness <1%
Observability: dashboards for token-cost per-req, p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rates, and per-route tracing configured
SLOs: monitoring alerts and on-call runbook added; SLO burn rate thresholds defined
Security & Compliance: security review signed; embedding PII handling guidance documented
SDKs: compatibility tests run and shim added if required to preserve older client contracts
Support & Docs: migration guide and FAQ written; outbound comms drafted for enterprise customers
Legal: Terms/PSA impact reviewed for contract-level SLAs
Load: capacity tests at 2x expected peak runbook executed
Chaos: failure injection test (model crash, region failover) executed and rollback validated
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Behavioral changes cause client integration breakage — Mitigation: provide compatibility shims and 90-day deprecation window
Risk: Increased token cost due to different default batching — Mitigation: default batch and cache configs tuned and communicated
Risk: Embedding dimension mismatch for existing customers — Mitigation: explicit model-name to dimension mapping and warning in SDKs
Risk: Latency regression at scale — Mitigation: pre-rollout load tests and staged capacity increases with auto-scaling policy guards
notes: Work aligns with the Unified Endpoint Stability program and feeds into Dedicated contract requirements
Design and engineering review scheduled 2025-01-22 to finalize response schema for function-calling in chat
We will coordinate a partner beta with two strategic customers (FinanceCorp, Searchly) for embedding migration feedback
